summary:
GE Aerospace 憑藉強勁的引擎交付與售後服務需求，營收與獲利雙雙優於市場預期。
• 營收年增 21.10% 至 133.5 億美元，顯示航空市場需求持續強勁。
• EPS 達 2.02 美元，優於市場預期的 1.86 美元。
• 售後服務業務表現亮眼，成為獲利成長的主要驅動力。
• 商用引擎交付量維持高檔，展現強大的供應鏈執行力。
ai_view:
觀點：財報釋出強勁成長訊號，顯示航空業復甦與售後服務的高獲利能力。短中期內，強勁的訂單積壓將支撐股價表現。投資人應持續追蹤供應鏈產能瓶頸的緩解進度，以及全球航空旅遊需求的持續性，這將是維持高估值的關鍵。

需留意：全球供應鏈瓶頸可能限制引擎產能擴張速度。；高達 38.20 的本益比反映市場對未來成長的高期待，若成長放緩恐面臨估值修正壓力。

summary_en:
GE Aerospace delivered strong earnings and revenue growth, driven by robust engine deliveries and high-margin aftermarket services.
• Revenue grew 21.10% YoY to $13.35 billion, reflecting sustained strength in aerospace demand.
• EPS of $2.02 outperformed the consensus estimate of $1.86.
• Strong performance in aftermarket services served as a primary driver for margin expansion.
• Commercial engine delivery volume remained robust, demonstrating effective supply chain execution.

ai_view_en:
View: The results signal strong growth, highlighting the profitability of the aerospace aftermarket. In the near-to-mid term, a robust backlog should support share price performance. Investors should monitor the progress of supply chain bottleneck resolutions and the sustainability of global air travel demand, which are critical to maintaining the current valuation.

Watch：Persistent global supply chain bottlenecks may constrain the pace of engine production expansion.; The trailing P/E ratio of 38.20 reflects high growth expectations, leaving the stock vulnerable to valuation compression if growth decelerates.
beat_or_miss: 超預期：EPS 超出預期 8.62%，營收年增率達 21.10%。
